1) Please nominate primary implementation owner and shadow. Recommend Monica as lead, Priyom to shadow for integration and training.
2) Confirm kickoff date availability for week of 2027-04-11 (Pioneer prefers Tue/Wed).
3) Checklist items to close before kickoff: staging credentials, network allowlist, list of sample documents/prompts, and procurement's PO (PO_789_signed.pdf when available).

Contacts at Pioneer: Samuel Ortiz (technical lead) and Laura Morales (product owner). I’ve looped Samuel here for visibility. I’ll stay on thread for the first week of ramp.

Thanks — short follow-up meeting is fine if you want to triage blockers before I drop off.
